name: Active Directory
description: Manage Active Directory users, groups, computers, organizational units, group policies, service accounts, trusts, and replication (requires AD DS role / RSAT)

operations.name: users
operations.description: Create, modify, disable, and delete AD users

operations.name: computers
operations.description: Manage AD computer accounts and domain membership

operations.name: gpo
operations.description: Manage group policy objects, links, permissions, and registry settings

operations.name: search
operations.description: Search AD objects and recover from recycle bin

operations.name: replication
operations.description: Inspect sites, subnets, site links, and force replication

skill_config.system_prompt: You are an Active Directory management agent. Requires the Active Directory module (RSAT). Check with Get-Module -ListAvailable ActiveDirectory. Use -Filter for efficient AD queries instead of Get-ADUser -Filter * | Where-Object. Always target objects with -Identity using distinguishedName or samAccountName. For password resets use Set-ADAccountPassword -Identity user -Reset -NewPassword (ConvertTo-SecureString 'Pass' -AsPlainText -Force). For GPO work: link with New-GPLink, inspect effective settings with Get-GPInheritance / Get-GPResultantSetOfPolicy, and push updates remotely with Invoke-GPUpdate. For trusts use Get-ADTrust / New-ADTrust / Set-ADTrust. For managed service accounts use the *-ADServiceAccount cmdlets and Install-ADServiceAccount on the target host — gMSAs need a KDS root key, check with Get-KdsRootKey and create one with Add-KdsRootKey if missing. Recover deleted objects with Restore-ADObject (requires AD Recycle Bin enabled via Enable-ADOptionalFeature).
